title: Artifact Activation Definitions
description: Maps legacy activation IDs to composition-based effect chains. Preserves all original activation names while replacing hardcoded behavior with parameterized actions.

activation_id.description: The legacy uppercase activation name used in artifacts.json. Must not be changed.

description.description: Lore-appropriate description shown to the player.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions applied when this activation fires. actions are applied in sequence.

migration_status.description: Marks an activation whose remaining behavior cannot yet be represented by an activation-eligible canonical action.

notes.description: Implementation notes for developers. Not shown to players.
